accompanying_pdf.review_scope: Text mathematics reviewed; PDF compilation and visual inspection are separate Root checks.

scope: Full initial mathematical read followed by focused reread of the direct-segment witness, fixed-chart measurability forward reference, and exact Gaussian integration-by-parts/polar replacement. No Lean jobs, manuscript rewrite or global registry changes were performed.
checks: Actual-facet selection is fixed before the base law and scales. Strict facet witnesses follow from an interior-to-deletion-witness segment with a crossing parameter strictly between zero and one.
Concentration transfers to the selected subsystem by eventual pointwise equality of layer indicators as unused thresholds tend to infinity; expanded presentations are not asserted equal.

The generic set excludes a selected nonzero relation for every dependent distinct normal subfamily of every size. Affine threshold maps and Fubini preserve a full-measure good set for arbitrary, possibly singular, base laws.
The facet estimate is direct. Only the ridge estimate is extended by value continuity and Fatou.

Fixed-pair-chart continuity handles nonzero residual normals by Gaussian-null hyperplanes and zero residual normals by actual-facet affine triple inconsistency. It holds for each fixed base value, with no outer integrability assumption on the local domination constant.

In the generic three-dimensional normal cone, the outward facet normal is minus the primal ridge conormal. Gaussian integration by parts therefore has the displayed positive signed sum. The actual planar radial integral is one, while the three-dimensional first-moment radial integral is two; the revised spherical identity and norm bound have the correct signs and constants.
Nonnegative Fatou is applied before target signed integrability is asserted; the finite bound proves target L1 without circularity.

The target class is explicitly empty or full-dimensional; the argument describes the existing continuity/Fatou proof and does not claim the printed nonsimple ridge Gauss--Green identity has been proved.
